paragraphs.text: Elders and sisters, the very next file, the very next podcast, will be a progressive muscle relaxation exercise that I will talk you through. You can use it whenever you're feeling stressed. I try to use it twice a day just as a way of staying relaxed and sort of in control.

But I use it like once in the middle of the day or in the morning and I use it once before I go to sleep. When using it before I go to sleep, I just go to sleep. Sometimes I go to sleep in the middle of it, sometimes I go to sleep at the end of it. It doesn't really matter whether the exercise is over or not, it will just finish and you'll be sleeping.

If I'm using it during the day, I will complete the exercise and then just gradually begin to bring my awareness back to a normal level. I will move a little bit without getting up, like moving my fingers and toes and arms and legs just a little bit, just to kind of get that movement back.

Within a few minutes, I'll feel fully alert and ready for the day. When I feel alert, when I feel like I'm fully back to my normal awareness level, then I'll stand back up and get back to the test of the day and get back, you know, getting ready for what I've got to do that day.

Okay, so this next file is the PMR. I hope you enjoy it, but if you don't, please don't worry about it. It's no big deal. You can use it or not as you wish. It's just there in case you need it. Alright, thanks very much and I hope you enjoy it.
